title: Elderly Fashion Dance • We Are The Late Light | Surreal AI Music Video 4K
description:
I’ve missed you.

One of my favorite parts of making these films is reading your comments. No matter where you live, we somehow keep meeting in the same place - somewhere between music, memory, and imagination.

For this episode, I wanted to create something joyful.

I combined surreal fashion, dance, and two original songs that stayed with me long after I finished writing them. In fact, I wrote three songs for this project, but only used two. The third is waiting quietly for another day.

This film took longer than most. I spent countless hours adjusting light, movement, and camera angles because I wanted the dancers to glow from within. I wanted every face, every wrinkle, every flowing piece of fabric to feel alive.

One morning while working on the music, I started dancing around my kitchen with my two dogs. They immediately joined in. Watching them bounce around the room reminded me of something simple:

Joy doesn’t belong to youth.

It belongs to anyone willing to feel it.

This film is for everyone who has lived a little, loved a lot, and still believes there is something beautiful ahead.

Thank you for being here. I hope these songs, these dancers, and this strange little world bring a smile to your day.

—

top_comments.text:
I am not a fan of AI, most videos irritate me immensely, especially when people comment thinking what they watched was reality. It feels like we are being fooled. 
But this is what AI is created for, honesty, beauty and joy. Well done, just brilliant imagining. I keep thinking what on earth you told it  to create those amazing outfits. Love it. More please.

top_comments.author: @idillard
top_comments.text: OMG that was amazing! The beauty, the elegance, the smiles, the absolute joy came through! Loved every second!

top_comments.author: @Audrey-i3m4d
top_comments.text: I still can't believe what I watched. The costumes are from a far off planet and the movement is so aligned to them.... breathtaking, mystical, stunning.

top_comments.author: @therealhellkitty5388
top_comments.text: Happy Juneteenth! I am a 65yo WW. Yesterday, wearing a matching linen jacket and dress, I was shopping for a few items. Went to the register and the young male cashier looked at me and said, “I really love your vibe”. In the parking lot of my local grocery, a young couple said I must be the “cool grandma”. I’m not doing anything special but I guess it’s something done well. All you have to do is think about presentation a tiny bit. Love this video, I need a few of these outfits, especially the ones with big, flowing skirts.
